    def LargeIndecomposable.ClosedZigzagTransfer.forbiddenCrossSubmodule {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Type x} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u, x} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] {n : ℕ} (D : CategoryTheory.Functor (LinearPathCategory.Category k (ClosedZigzag.Vertex n)ᵒᵖ) C) [D.Additive] [CategoryTheory.Functor.Linear k D] (X' Y' : LinearPathCategory.Category k (ClosedZigzag.Vertex n)ᵒᵖ) :
    Submodule k (D.obj X' ⟶ D.obj Y')

    The span of all ambient cross composites landing in one source Hom space. The middle source Hom is required to be empty; these are exactly the terms that a two-variable cleavage coefficient must annihilate.

        structure LargeIndecomposable.ClosedZigzagTransfer.ClosedZigzagSupplementData {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Type x} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u, x} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (D : CategoryTheory.Functor (LinearPathCategory.Category k (ClosedZigzag.Vertex n)ᵒᵖ) C) [D.Additive] [CategoryTheory.Functor.Linear k D] :
        Type u

        Source-faithful BGRS supplement data. Unlike the stronger principal-span boundary, this asks only that the landing path generator not lie in the sum of its endpoint radical layer and the cross-composite space. This is exactly the nonmembership established by the power calculation in BGRS 3.7.
